title: The recommended way to study
summary: How often, how long and in which mode.
focus: A study routine that makes learning stick
content:
## Deep study

Study for at least 30 minutes, 3 times a week. Use Study mode or the Guide. Take notes by writing things down. Writing helps you remember.

The **My note** box on a lesson holds up to 500 characters. For longer notes, use paper.

## Check yourself

Take the lesson quiz right after you study. On the lesson page, answer the reading check, then press **Practise this lesson**.

## Keep it fresh

Spend a few minutes on questions from lessons you have already studied. Press **Start recommended practice** on the home page. Use the **Review mix** in Sprint mode, the **Mistakes** tab, and flashcards when the **Words due** card shows.

## Short bursts

When you have 5 to 10 minutes, use Sprint mode or Play mode. They help the ideas settle.

You can learn in Sprint mode too. It will not stick as well as deep focus time.

vocabulary.meaning: a long, undistracted study session of 30 minutes or more
a quiz picked from lessons you have read, weak topics first
what you write down by hand while you study

quiz.prompt: At least how many minutes should a deep study session last?
quiz.explanation: Aim for at least 30 minutes of focused study.

quiz.prompt: How many times a week should you do deep study?
quiz.explanation: Study at least 3 times a week.
hints: It is more than two and fewer than four.

quiz.prompt: When should you take the lesson quiz?
quiz.explanation: Testing yourself right after studying helps it stick.
hints: Do it while the lesson is fresh.

quiz.prompt: What is a good use of 5 to 10 spare minutes?
quiz.explanation: Short bursts in Sprint or Play help the ideas settle.
hints: Think of the modes made for short time.

quiz.prompt: Learning only in Sprint mode sticks as well as deep focus time.
quiz.explanation: You can learn in Sprint mode, but it will not stick as well as deep focus time.
hints: Deep focus is the main way to learn.

sorts.title: Deep focus or short burst?

items.text: 30 minutes in Study mode with notes on paper
A Sprint session on the bus
A Guide stage with a pen in hand
A Lightning round while you wait

sorts.why: Deep time is for learning. Short bursts keep it fresh.
